title: Extend Video with H3 fails at 6, 8 or 10 seconds added: the audio splice counts back from the end of audio that is not the picture's length
description: Fabio hit 'MpiAudioSplice ... runs 267 samples past the end' asking the agent for an 8 s H3 extend (2026-09-29). flow_h3_extend #953 places the 24-frame audio re-take counting back from the END of the joined track, assuming the generated audio is exactly L picture frames long. H3 decodes round(L*40/24) audio steps, so whenever L is not a multiple of 3 the audio is 1/3 step (267 samples) longer (raises) or shorter (splices 8 ms early, silently). Offline replay: 192 of 240 duration x context x source combos raise or misplace; only 2 s and 4 s at the default context are clean, which is why the verified runs passed. Fix: anchor the splice at the join (source frames - 24), where the alignment is defined.
